purpose: Provides utilities for managing annotator experiment run records. Builds summaries and human-readable reports from measurement results, and cleans completed runs by sanitizing sensitive paths in JSON manifests and deleting files containing leaked credentials.

public_api.name: utc_run_directory
public_api.role: Returns a new UTC-formatted directory path below experiments/annotator/runs. Called to create timestamped output directories for experiment runs.

public_api.name: count_ignored_npy
public_api.role: Counts and totals byte size of .npy files in a run directory. Used to report ignored array artifacts in summaries.

public_api.name: human_bytes
public_api.role: Formats byte totals into readable units (bytes/KiB/MiB/GiB). Used in reports and terminal output.

public_api.name: build_summary
public_api.role: Collects root and configuration manifests plus metrics from a completed run into a structured dict. Called to assemble data for summary.json after a successful measurement.

public_api.name: format_report
public_api.role: Renders a markdown table report showing performance metrics across configurations. Called to produce human-readable output from a summary.

public_api.name: write_summary_and_report
public_api.role: Writes summary.json and report.md files after a successful run. Called after measurement completes to record results.

public_api.name: clean_run
public_api.role: Backs up and cleans a completed run by sanitizing sensitive paths in JSON and deleting files with leaked credentials. Returns the archive path if cleanup was needed; called to prepare runs for version control.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point that accepts a run directory path and calls clean_run. Used when invoking the module as a standalone script.
